title: Supercell
description: Supercell's official brand guidelines define the primary colours Supercell Black (#000000) and Supercell White (#FFFFFF), the accent colours Supercell Blue (#2D85F3), Supercell Green (#21C49F), Supercell Pink (#FB62AA) and Supercell Yellow (#F7DB1C), and the supporting greys Dark Gray (#191919), Medium Gray (#666666), Light Gray (#F2F2F2) and Gray (#CCCCCC).
